title: Written-Off Value and the Reinstated Term — Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers
content:
**Accounting basis.** When a credit of Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers expires with value remaining, the value is written off in an expiry write-off entry. When the credit is reinstated, its reinstated term counts written-off-value months, which are set by the value written off at its expiry. That value is the amount of the credit's expiry write-off entries.

| Value written off at expiry (USD) | Written-off-value months |
|---|---|
| 500.00 or more | 2 months |
| at least 250.00 but below 500.00 | 1 month |
| below 250.00 | none |

The same rule in words: 2 months when the value written off is at least 500 US dollars; 1 month when it is at least 250 US dollars but below 500; none when it is below 250.

## Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical write-offs)

| Expiry write-off amount | Side of the threshold | Written-off-value months |
|---|---|---|
| 500.00 | at the 500 threshold, which counts as reached | 2 |
| 499.99 | just below 500, at least 250 | 1 |
| 250.00 | at the 250 threshold, which counts as reached | 1 |
| 249.99 | just below 250 | none |
| 0.00 | below 250 | none |

The amounts are examples. What decides the months is the amount the credit's own expiry write-off entries show.
